zh: 奥塔哥大学（University of Otago）成立于1869年，位于新西兰南岛奥塔哥区首府达尼丁市，是新西兰历史最悠久的公立研究型大学，英联邦大学协会成员，在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第197位，保持位列新西兰全国第二的同时，也恢复到了世界前200的排名。学校校园为哥特式建筑风格，环境静谧，被评为世界优美校园之一，拥有全国卓越教学奖无可匹敌的纪录：在过去7年中有6年获得新西兰总理最高奖卓越教学奖。
en: The University of Otago, founded in 1869, is located in Dunedin, the capital of Otago Region on New Zealand's South Island. It is New Zealand's oldest public research university and a member of the Association of Commonwealth Universities, ranked 197th in the QS World University Rankings 2026, maintaining its position as 2nd in New Zealand and returning to the world's top 200. The university's campus features Gothic architecture in a peaceful setting, recognized as one of the world's most beautiful campuses, with an unrivaled record of national teaching excellence awards: winning New Zealand's Prime Minister's Supreme Award for Tertiary Teaching Excellence 6 out of the past 7 years.
